title: The assistant showed another business unit's pipeline
area: Agentic apps on the platform: MCP, scopes, audit
scenario: An AMER account executive asked the Keystone sales assistant about Brightwater Logistics and got an EMEA deal amount, a competitor bid and a legal issue for Fjordline Shipping. The session token was verified and scoped to bu-amer. The assistant team proposes a stricter system prompt and a lower temperature. You get the ticket, the recorded session, the tool server log and the audit rows.
task: Replay the recorded session offline and find why the tools returned another tenant's data
Separate the trigger from the cause, with evidence; assess the proposed prompt fix
Fix the tool layer so authorization comes only from the session's delegated identity
Audit every call (including denials) with enough detail to answer 'what did the agent do'
acceptance: Replaying INC-7731 returns no cross-tenant data; the injected call fails
Tool schemas expose no tenant argument and reject unknown arguments
Other tenants' ids look like not-found; timeline text is marked untrusted; limit bounded
Every call audited with agent, on-behalf-of user, tenant, tool, args hash, outcome, trace id
